_doc: The plan of a generated city and world/arch.ts civicFor. A building's storeys are its body's (sim/buildings/b40). decay_span_min: the span a generated building's age is drawn from (growth.cpp generated_age) and the minutes of age a blow's wear takes off at its full share (strike_buildings.cpp). road_roles: the profile each road the generator lays takes (sim/citygen road_gen: the local street, the avenue, the one with a cycle track, the expressway, the collector, the wide-sidewalk street, the urban street, the cobbled one, the one with a median, the concrete road, the one with a bike lane, the one with a kerbside bus lane, the boulevard, the four-lane avenue), by its id in road_profiles.json. occupied_share: a lot is taken when a building stands within this share of the sum of the lot's and the building's half sizes (the 4.0's).

plan._doc: The city's shape, authored as the 4.0's world/cityGen/plan.ts has it: no survey behind these numbers. heat = 1 - distance share + density term + noise; the thresholds make it low, medium or high, and commerce on main roads.

shapes._doc: Every value a city generator file tunes, one block per file (sim/citygen; the lots' sizes shared by the block cutter and the strips), read into GrowthDef::shapes (sim/catalog/gen_shapes.h); a missing key refuses the catalogue.

roads._doc: The generated city's grid and its march over the land (road_gen.cpp; the 4.0's cityGen.ts and cityField.ts numbers, no source behind them yet): blocks block_along by block_across m over grid_span radii, the centre's share of the radius (centre_share), an avenue every avenue_every lines, points_along and points_across samples a block; the map edge's pad (edge_pad), the band inside the map's edge the grid stays out of (inside_margin), the land's clearance over the sea and water (land_clear), the longest bridge (max_wet), the steepest local and arterial grades; a street's section by district noise (district_scale_n, noise_m_scale) and its thresholds (avenue_share_n, urban_n, bike_n, cobble_d with cobble_m, urban_local_n; an avenue's bus_offset with bus_m, boulevard_m, av4_n).

graph._doc: The road graph (road_gen_graph.cpp, cityGen.ts): pieces filed in buckets of bucket m; nodes nearer than merge m are one, segments shorter than collapse m one node; a local street within hug_dist m of a stronger one and at least hug_cos parallel to it goes; generated segments of at most gen_seg_len m; at most max_links legs at a node (the tidy pass's cap too); components under min_component nodes go; a node's height from the ground at it and node_probe m round it, at least node_min_y m over the sea; the land beside a street read side_probe_m off its middle (about half a lot's depth).

tidy._doc: The graph opened clean (road_gen_tidy.cpp, cityGen.ts tidyGraph): no two roads leave a node closer than min_leg_angle degrees (roads/impossible.ts); a node meets a road no nearer than end_gap m to its ends, and pieces under min_piece m go; roads filed in cells of cell m, padded pad m; a node is on a road within its half carriageway (on_road_default without one, at least on_road_min) and on_road_dy m of its height; at most max_passes passes; a node of keeps_legs legs or more keeps its roads.

scenic._doc: The scenic city's roads (scenic_roads.cpp): each run laid in pieces of at most longest_run_m (the graph builder files a piece by its bounds).

block_lots._doc: The blocks cut into lots (block_lots.cpp, blockLots.ts): the land found on a raster of res m, blocks of at most max_block m; two rows back to back from two_rows m deep; a junction's plate plate_share of its widest road's half; a lot kept when land_share of its lattice (lattice_start, lattice_step) is land; the street sought street_probe m from a lot's front.

strips._doc: The lots along the streets (lot_gen.cpp, lots.ts): an occupancy grid of res m, a road's paving padded road_pad m; a lot is dry dry_min m over the sea, with water wet_clear m under the ground on a wet_step m lattice, and relief under max_relief m; it faces the street read facing_probe m before it, a road facing_pad m past its half, on facing_samples samples; arc tables of arc_steps samples; two ways out of a node opposed beyond straight_on are one street.

lots._doc: The lots' sizes (lot_place.cpp, block_lots.cpp; lots.ts LOT_DEPTH, LOT_FRONTAGE, MIN_LOT): depth_m deep, about frontage_m wide, at least least_m; works works_depth by works_frontage m (more than the 4.0 gives them: a lorry has to turn in the yard, and on its lots a tenth of the docks had no way in, yard_test); front_pad m off the footway, width_trim m apart; a run reads the land every along_step m, behind_footway m past the footway and back_in m short of its back (lots.ts streetPlan). Every lot's front and any side on a street are then brought to the paving's edge, paving_gap m off it, from as far as reach_m (lots.ts: a lot reaches past the street sides by 2.5 m and is cut back to the land, LAND_CLEARANCE 0.08 m off the paving).

lot_land._doc: A lot cut back to the land (lot_land.cpp): less than crossed_area_m2 off it is the paving's own outline, not a road through it; an outline edge of straight_back_m or more is a footway's straight back, shorter a corner's curve; two backs whose sine is under square_share are one street; a squared corner stands at most square_reach_m from the outline; sides front_slack_m further from the street than the nearest still face it, the street sought front_search_m round; a snap takes other lots' corners within lot_snap_share of its reach and the backs that make a corner within back_span of it, never a corner within apart_m of the one being moved.

paving._doc: The paving lots are cut against (lot_paving.cpp): a curve's outline in chords of along_pace_m, a junction's plate and a bulb as the ground takes them (sim/roads/junction.h node_outline), a plate standing at most plate_reach_m from the roads that meet it; the chords of a straight back are one side: outline_slack_units (2 cm) off a line is on it.

squares._doc: The generated squares (squares.cpp, squares.ts): lots filed in cells of file_cell_m while they are joined, a point seam_m past a lot's side still in it; the lawn lawn_h high and the walks twice it; the round plaza's rectangles full size and plaza_wide across; the trees' grid starts lattice_from_m out, so it lies the same on any block.

lot_rings._doc: The lots the player draws (sim/lots/lot_rings.cpp; the least lot is the lots block's least_m): two corners within near_m are one when lots are joined; a cut runs cut_past_m past the ring; a front side is at least side_least_m long, and the side the front is taken from scores off_angle_m a radian off parallel; a lot lies deep in another when a point inner_share of the way from a corner to the middle is inside it.
